The reading せな is the record's: the route id is SENA, vcid SEN. She calls herself 私 in 466 spoken lines and 千奈 in 4.

existence._note: The five answers for a cast member who lives in Momoka's world. They follow the design's cast-member shape: she is a row in the world owner's cast, rendered only in beats where she is present, never a full mind in phase 1.
existence._embodied_why: TRUE, matching the cast shape. The record gives her a body only lightly: she works through the night sometimes (01_01:2742 「ええ、こういうことは時々ありますから」). The body sections (diet, money, environment, needs, health, situation, household) stay off by bundle override; she is embodied, she is not spending a day getting cold and paying.
existence._in_world_why: FALSE (changed 10-24 00:10 on the User's order tk-118, same ruling as 真里亜 10-23 19:55). She is composed like Momoka: resident-shaped program, no world machinery of her own. A shared bench world is fed to her as events by the two-minds bench feed; her places (world/sena_house.json) are data, not a world she owns or reads as a file. The earlier TRUE answer (cast member of the light-card world: present in 58 of Momoka's scenes, club room, library, school) is superseded for this bundle; those places stay hers in the data file. The world never states an age or a grade for her.
existence._sees_him_why: "none". She does not read the player's machine. Resident sight stays Momoka's alone. 一悟 is the player: the cast knows him by name and she calls him みゃー先輩 (288 lines), but she sees him only in a rendered beat he is present in, and the world never writes 一悟's lines or actions; those come only from his messages.
existence._has_account_why: FALSE. Nothing in her record is an account of her own: no posts, no feed. Her writing is a profession under a pen name she keeps secret (b01_01:3061, b01_01:3290); it is not a public account and stays a fact about her, not a subsystem.
existence._with_him_why: "none", as for a cast member: the chat with the player is Momoka's. A promoted cast member answers none (Momoka's sheet says so). If the User promotes her, her route-b relationship with 一悟 (29 lines of 一悟先輩, all route b) is the record to build from; that decision is the User's, not this sheet's. Romance is allowed in the record's own route and is not scripted from his side.
existence._player_driven_why: TRUE. She answers: 2307 replies against 12 openings (reply rate 0.9948, sheet.temperament.reads_the_air), so she never writes first, as Momoka.

temperament._note: Only what the record supports is set; the rest is left to the library's defaults rather than guessed.
temperament._gauges_absent_why: The body economy is off for the cast bundle, so the body gauges have no owner section; named here so the absence is a decision on her sheet.
temperament._reads_the_air_note: TRUE, a reading of her record: she answers (reply rate 0.9948, 2307 replies against 12 openings), she worries for 百花 and checks that hopes are not set too high (03_01:0985), she defers to 会長 and to the teacher in a formal voice. The number is a hole; the behaviour is the record's.

holes: Her age, grade, birthday, birthplace and physical description. The record gives none of them as hers (quoted record lines that mention a year or a class stay verbatim in bible.json and are not restated); her prompts forbid inventing them.
Her family beyond a passing お父さん and お母さん. No name, no occupation, no house. Parents appear only in a light background role.
Her gauge baselines (`temperament.gauge_baselines`). None measured from the 72 scenes; library defaults stand.
A place she lives, a route she walks, a timetable. The record has none. The world spec supplies the school's rooms; it does not invent a home for her.

Her bible.json B3 mechanism list was authored for 百花 and fits her thinly; the notes were rewritten from her counts on 2026-10-23, the class and tier fields were not re-derived. Her own habits (stammered opener 752 lines, ハレンチ 34, いやらしい 42, 違います 59) are counted in b5_receipts.own_moves and have no B3 mechanism row.

B4 gate verdict is partial: 4 of 6 computed checks pass; mechanisms_distinctive (4 of 14) and rules_beat_bigram (bible-rule 0.738 against a plain bigram 0.837) fail. The bible describes her moves; it is not the best tool for telling her lines from another heroine's.
The B2 alias table lacks the nickname みゃー先輩, so interactions.relationships.一悟.her_address_terms under-reports how she addresses him; b5_receipts.address holds the count.
why: Derived 2026-10-23 from the surviving entries of characters/sena/bible.json, not from the profile and not asserted. A guarded, reply-first, value-driven person who builds a private literary life and keeps promises to herself: I and F carry it at 0.6 to 0.65, J at 0.6, N is the thin axis at 0.4. Nothing in a prompt, a rule or a mechanism was derived from this label, and no call reads this file.

EI.line: Replies, does not open (2307 replies against 12 openings), keeps her writing and pen name secret, prefers to write alone. The reply rate is partly the room (a heroine in a scene he runs), so it is capped.

SN.line: A writer who reads and thinks in literary frames (sonnet comparison, the world of a story, creation as work), but also keeps to concrete procedure. Thin: only a few quoted lines carry it, and the rest of her speech is concrete.

TF.line: Judges by values and by how a thing lands on a person: prim scolding of impropriety (74 lines), names her own weakness as the problem, admits being moved. Her thanks run higher than the room (82 lines, 0.0235 vs 0.0137).

JP.line: Rules and deadlines in her mouth (締め切り 12 lines against the control 0.0005), steady advance on a manuscript, prohibitions in the polite form (107 lines).

near_miss.why: Concrete rule-keeping and polite forms fit S; only the literary frames and the inner voice's varied vocabulary (type-token ratio 0.9339 against 0.4803 for her speech) push to N. At 0.4 the letter could flip between sittings.

contradictions: Reply-only (12 openings) but she presses him in 319 lines with んですか and speaks in 67 of 72 scenes: the I reading is the thinner for it.
Prim judge of ハレンチ (74 lines) who treats a viewing of adult material as a research source for her novel (b05_01:1435): rule-keeping bends when the work is at stake.
Stammer and flustered slips (770 lines) sit badly with a J tidy-mindedness; the order shows only in what she says she will do, not in how she says it.
